stories.title: Provider Search Request/Response Schema
stories.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty, filters) and outputs (provider list, scores, metadata) used by FindCareFacade.

stories.title: Vector Search with Taxonomy Fallback Logic
stories.description: Implement core provider search logic combining MongoDB Atlas vector search with fallback to NUCC taxonomy-based matching when vector results are insufficient.

stories.title: Specialty Identification and NUCC Mapping Integration
stories.description: Integrate specialty extraction pipeline (regex + vector + AI expansion) and map results to NUCC codes for use in provider search queries.

stories.title: FindCareFacade API Integration
stories.description: Expose provider search through FindCareFacade and tool_router, ensuring validated inputs, tool dispatch, and structured responses for chat consumption.

stories.title: Provider Search Testing and Result Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering vector search accuracy, taxonomy fallback behavior, specialty mapping, and end-to-end facade invocation.
